description: This file defines the PdfExtGState class, representing an extended graphics state object within the PDFsharp library. It includes properties and methods to configure transparency and overprint settings for PDF graphics rendering.

classes.name: PdfExtGState
classes.description: Represents an extended graphics state object with properties for transparency and overprint, inheriting from PdfDictionary.

classes.name: PdfExtGState.Keys
classes.description: Contains static key definitions for the PdfExtGState dictionary entries, such as type, opacity, overprint flags, and additional graphics state parameters.

methods.name: SetDefault1
methods.description: Sets default graphics state parameters suitable for certain rendering contexts, with alpha, overprint, and other options.

methods.name: SetDefault2
methods.description: Sets alternative default parameters possibly used for shading patterns, with different overprint settings.

methods.name: MakeKey
methods.description: Creates a composite key string based on alpha transparency value and overprint flag, useful for caching or identifying states.

methods.name: UpdateKey
methods.description: Updates the internal key string used to identify the current graphics state configuration based on current property values.
